Introduction
HTML is a markup language used to create web pages. It provides a way to structure and
display content on the web. HTML is a standard for the creation of web pages and web
applications.

HTML is a markup language, which means it uses tags to define the structure and meaning
of the content. HTML tags are enclosed in angle brackets, like `<html>`, `<head>`, and
`<body>`. These tags are used to define the different parts of a web page.
